verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents per-project dashboard views: filtering by release to see which release introduced errors, a timeline with release annotations correlating versions with error-rate changes, a filter for errors introduced in the last 24 hours, stability tracking against targets, and grouping that surfaces the highest-impact issues. Nothing shows an aggregated view across projects or teams, or a dedicated top-regressions view. The Data Access API is only a building block for custom reporting and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: cross-project/cross-team aggregated dashboards, an explicit top-regressions trend view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of trend dashboards.
